english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for making something stronger or reinforcing it, including an army or other organization.
Use this when making an existing effect, capability, or feature stronger, especially by adding functionality.
Use this when making a thing, system, effect, or situation stronger rather than simply holding it in place.
Use this when heightening means making an effect, force, feeling, or intensity stronger.
Use this with a signal when the focus is on strengthening it rather than describing the technical amplification process.

examples.english: We need to strengthen security so no one can take advantage.
examples.traditional: 我哋要加強保安，唔好畀人有機可乘。
